caseNameFull: CITY OF PENSACOLA, FLORIDA v. Amanda KONDRAT'YEV

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit for further consideration in light of American Legion v. American Humanist Assn. , 588 U.S. ----, 139 S.Ct. 2067, --- L.E.2d ---- (2019).
